name: Insurance
description: Property & casualty and life insurance underwriting, claims, and reserves.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business (auto, home, commercial, life, annuity)

metrics.name: incurred_losses
metrics.description: Paid losses plus change in reserves in the period

metrics.name: loss_ratio
metrics.description: Incurred losses and loss adjustment expense divided by earned premium

metrics.name: reserves
metrics.description: Loss reserves at a point in time

conventions.rule: Written and earned premium differ by timing; ratios use earned premium.
Loss ratios for recent accident years are immature and develop over time; compare at equal development age.
A combined ratio below 100% means an underwriting profit, before investment income.

insight_rules.reason: Attribute via losses and premium separately.

caveats.text: Catastrophe events dominate some periods; show results with and without catastrophe losses.

chart_conventions.rule: Show loss development as a triangle table (accident year by development age).

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
